desc:
🛴 STEAL. ESCAPE. COLLECT!

Sneak into the Steal Zone, grab a case and escape the guards! Bring it back to your plot, open it and discover your next Kukirin.

📦 Steal cases with different rarities and sizes.
🏃 Train your Speed, upgrade your treadmill and outrun tougher guards.
🛴 Collect 43 scooter models and build your dream garage.
💰 Display scooters on your plot to earn Money.
🌍 Explore 9 biomes with faster guards and better cases.
🌙 Cases open 4× faster at night!
🎁 Claim daily and online rewards.

New here? Follow the arrows to your first case and scooter.
Play on mobile or PC.

The game is being improved — use Feedback to report bugs or share ideas!
